Subject: Draft: benchmarking matrix & acceptance SLOs (MAP)

Tom — attaching the draft benchmarking matrix we discussed for the MAP. High level: we ran a lightweight synthetic and a representative request trace slice so you can see both steady-state throughput and realistic TTFT behavior. Key pieces included in the attached CSV: P50/P90/P95 latency at 1x/5x/10x concurrency, tokens/sec throughput, and end-to-end TTFT (first token) for a set of 6 representative templates you shared last week.

Asks:
- Could you confirm the representative templates (I listed them in the first sheet) — any edits?
- Are the acceptance gates below reasonable for your program team? We proposed P95 <= 400ms (chat-short), TTFT <= 300ms median, and 100 req/s sustained per instance for the medium profile.

I call out two things we want to highlight in the MAP:
1) Canary rollout gating: pass performance on the "medium" workload at 2x expected concurrency for 48 hours before full cutover.
2) Fallback policy: when less than 90% of requests meet P95, auto-failover to a lower-latency model variant.

Attachment: symphony_bench_results_20270530.csv (summary + raw run logs). Also uploaded a tightened MAP PDF to the share (see link).

-ben

Subject: RE: Draft: benchmarking matrix & acceptance SLOs (MAP) — updated runs

Tom — quick follow-up after re-running with per-flow breakdown and adding a pass/fail column as requested. Summary (see attached CSV):
- Flow A (short chat): P95 = 320ms, median TTFT = 210ms, sustained throughput per instance = 130 req/s (pass)
- Flow B (long-context): P95 = 720ms, median TTFT = 620ms, sustained throughput = 55 req/s (needs work)
- Flow C (batch summarization): P95 = 1.2s, median TTFT = 1.1s, throughput 18 req/s (expected given token counts)

Notes and proposals:
- For Flow B we recommend a lightweight token-quantization profile and increasing KV cache TTL for session affinity; this brings P95 down ~30% in our lab.
- Proposed acceptance gates for the MAP:
  * Short-chat: P95 <= 400ms AND TTFT median <= 300ms
  * Long-context: P95 <= 600ms OR documented mitigation in MAP (e.g., reduced window or model variant)
  * Throughput: plateau >= 80% of expected peak for a 60-minute sustained run

Attachment: symphony_bench_results_20270601.csv (per-flow breakdown + pass_fail column).

-ben

Team — internal note before I reply to Tom and Procurement. I reviewed the per-flow runs. Suggested redlines to MAP:
- Change the 72-hour pilot ask to a two-stage pilot: Stage 1 (48h) with synthetic spike tests to validate autoscaler behavior; Stage 2 (72h) with production traffic slice for acceptance automation. This reduces risk and shortens procurement gating.
- Add an explicit rollback SLA: if >15% of requests across the pilot window fail performance gates for two consecutive 15-minute windows, revert to previous configuration and notify Symphony ops.
- Capture mitigation playbooks in the MAP appendix: quantization toggles, KV cache tuning, and model-variant route table. Include runbook links.

I'll include a short canary timeline in my reply and offer the 6/14 week for the pilot.

-marissa
